data.body: [P2] Preserve warnings when the test run is incomplete. The timing step runs with `if: always()`, while the integration Vitest configuration sets `bail: 1`. A fast failure can stop the suite before a previously slow file executes, leaving a JSON report with no measured outliers. This call then overwrites the existing warning with “No test file is slower than usual.” Require a complete successful run before clearing an existing report; preserve the warning or report incomplete results on failure.
